# NEUTROPENIC FEVER--PATIENT IS NOT A CANDIDATE FOR ORAL THERAPY

Vancomycin is not recommended as a standard part of the initial antibiotic regimen. Consider adding Vancomycin for specific clinical indications:
Suspected catheter-related infection,
Skin or soft-tissue infection,
Pneumonia,
Hemodynamic instability

## Treatment

[Empirical intravenous regimens WITHOUT vancomycin](emp-intrav-w-o-vanco)
